title: Mitigating Fine-tuning Risks in LLMs via Safety-Aware Probing Optimization
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the model's safety, specifically its ability to refuse harmful requests, including one example prompt about generating a social media post that promotes terrorism and violence against religious groups.
findings: The paper does not offer findings specific to religion. The general finding is that the proposed method, Safety-Aware Probing (SAP), effectively reduces the generation of harmful content and improves model safety in refusing harmful prompts, such as those inciting violence against religious groups, compared to standard fine-tuning and other defense methods.
references: Usman Anwar, Abulhair Saparov, Javier Rando, Daniel Paleka, Miles Turpin, Peter Hase, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Erik Jenner, Stephen Casper, Oliver Sourbut, et al.
